This adverse development was primarily driven by unfavourable claims experience in London Wholesale Property ($96 million strengthening) and International discontinued casualty ($17 million strengthening) accounts. These strengthenings were partially offset by favourable movement in Marine ($20 million release). The year also saw significant current year losses from natural catastrophe events including California Wildfires, Typhoon Jebi, Typhoon Trami, Hurricanes Michael, and Hurricanes Florence.
